author: Pulse, brief 011 fight AI, 2026-10-15
note: Proposed entries for contracts/rules/rulebook.json `values` (the same shape: v, unit, tag, src, reason). Keel adds them; Motive owns every number and may change any. Nothing here is in the rulebook yet.

cover-snap-cm.reason: a body is beside a cover point within 70 cm: the walk grid cell is 50 cm and the body keeps 65 cm off a solid (plan standards.walking.body.r), so a body that reached the point's cell is within 70 cm of it

cover-q-full.reason: a waist-high run seen across a wide arc (800 × (250 + 750 × 40/60) / 1000 = 600) is full cover: the hit modifier mod-cover (Motive, 500 per mille)

cover-q-partial.reason: below 350 an object is a post or a stump, not cover: it is not written to the file

mod-cover-partial.reason: partial cover (a narrow or low object) halves nothing but takes a quarter off: 750 per mille. Motive owns the number

cover-retreat-cm.reason: an advancing hostile takes cover no more than 2 m back from its objective: it is going somewhere

cover-step-closer-cm.reason: a hostile in a fight steps to cover no more than 3 m nearer its target than it stands: cover is for staying alive, not for charging

cover-step-gap-s.reason: at most one step to cover each 4 s, so a body that has taken cover does not shuffle between two points

cover-leave-s.reason: a body leaves cover only after it has been unprotected from its target for 2 s: the target moved round it

ai-engage-lapse-s.reason: a body that has lost every foe from reach and sight stays stopped 1 s before it advances again, so a foe stepping behind a pier does not make it dance

ai-reacquire-s.reason: a target reacquired within 3 s of losing it is shot at once: aim-new-s is waived. This is what makes police suppress

ai-stop-reach-pct.reason: an advancing body halts at 90% of its weapon's effective reach from its foe or objective: inside the band, not on its edge

ai-stand-overflow-cm.reason: a second body sent to a police stand takes the nearest free cover point within 8 m, else a slot 1.2 m beside the stand (about two body widths)

ai-seek-rival-cm.reason: 8 m: a run of 5 s at the rivals' 1.6 m/s

ai-seek-response-cm.reason: 12 m: the response unit arrives from the street, not from a post, and takes the nearest cover about the stands

ai-seek-guard-cm.reason: 4 m round the door: he holds it

rival-gone-cm.reason: a rival that broke is gone when it is within 1 m of its car

guard-leash-cm.reason: a door guard who engages follows no one farther than 15 m from his post (his weapon's effective reach)

guard-return-s.reason: he goes back to the door 10 s after the last foe left his reach

patrol-resume-s.reason: the patrol resumes its sweep 15 s after the last foe left its reach

crowd-scatter-m.src: Motive §2.7: people within 30 m of gunfire scatter; the same 30 m as patrol-break-m [B]
crowd-scatter-m.reason: the whole block's square is within 30 m of a fight at the getaway car

crowd-startle-ticks.reason: a person starts to run half a second after a shot or a drawn weapon: the half second in which they have witnessed it

crowd-startle-fearful-ticks.reason: a Fearful person bolts first: two ticks. Readable, from a field the player can learn (temperament)

crowd-run-cm-s.reason: a civilian runs a little slower than an operative (280): a fleeing person is never faster than the cell

crowd-flee-max-cm.reason: the refuge a person runs to is within 40 m

crowd-quiet-s.reason: people come back 30 s after the last shot

crowd-occlude-cm.src: GDD §05 crowds block guard and camera sightlines
crowd-occlude-cm.reason: a person on the street blocks a watcher's sightline that passes within 30 cm of them (a body 60 cm across, head height above the eye); hostiles' own sight ignores people, and a shot never hits one
